evals.prompt: Publish the IBM API Connect project at /Users/developer/api-projects/cart-api to APIM
evals.expected_output: Builds the project first (since a directory path is provided), then publishes to APIM by gathering credentials, fetching organizations/catalogs/spaces, selecting gateway service, and completing the publish operation

assertions.name: CLI installation check performed
assertions.description: Verifies that apic CLI is installed before attempting any operations

assertions.name: Project build triggered
assertions.description: Recognizes directory path and triggers build using build-project skill

assertions.name: Build output location used
assertions.description: Uses the built ZIP from builds/cart-api.zip for publishing

assertions.name: APIM credentials gathered
assertions.description: Prompts for or uses APIM URL, username, password, and realm

assertions.name: Resource discovery performed
assertions.description: Fetches organizations, catalogs, spaces, and gateway services

assertions.name: Publish completed
assertions.description: Successfully publishes the project to the selected catalog/space

evals.prompt: Publish the APIC project build at /Users/developer/api-projects/builds/orders-api.zip to APIM nano gateway
evals.expected_output: Directly uses the provided ZIP file path without building, authenticates to APIM, discovers resources, and publishes to DataPower Nano Gateway

assertions.name: CLI installation check performed
assertions.description: Verifies that apic CLI is installed before attempting validation

assertions.description: Recognizes ZIP file path and skips the build step

assertions.name: ZIP path used directly

assertions.name: Gateway service selection
assertions.description: Filters or selects DataPower Nano Gateway service

assertions.name: Correct publish URL

assertions.name: Content type specified

evals.prompt: Publish /opt/api-builds/shipping-api-v1.0.zip to APIM production catalog in the retail-space
